# statusdrift_status_page_announcement (Resource)

Manages a StatusDrift status page announcement.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "statusdrift_status_page_announcement" "maintenance_notice" {
  status_page_id = statusdrift_status_page.public.id
  title          = "Scheduled Maintenance"
  content        = "We will be performing scheduled maintenance on our API servers."
  type           = "maintenance"
  enabled        = true
  starts_at      = "2025-03-20T02:00:00Z"
  ends_at        = "2025-03-20T06:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The content of the announcement.
- `status_page_id` (Number) The ID of the status page this announcement belongs to.
- `title` (String) The title of the announcement.
- `type` (String) The type of announcement. Valid values: info, warning, critical, maintenance, success.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the announcement is enabled.
- `ends_at` (String) The end date and time in ISO 8601 format.
- `starts_at` (String) The start date and time in ISO 8601 format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique identifier of the announcement.
